description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ConfigFormBase' for creating system configuration forms in Drupal. It includes methods for building forms, loading default values from configuration, storing configuration keys, validating, and submitting forms, as well as handling configuration overrides.

classes.name: ConfigFormBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing a foundation for Drupal system configuration forms, handling form building, validation, submission, and configuration override management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form, setting theme, actions, and loading default values.

methods.name: loadDefaultValuesFromConfig
methods.description: Recursively loads default configuration values into form elements with '#config_target'.

methods.name: storeConfigKeyToFormElementMap
methods.description: Stores a map of configuration keys to form element parents after form build.

methods.name: doStoreConfigMap
methods.description: Helper for storing configuration key mappings recursively.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates form input against configuration schema and sets error messages.

methods.name: formatMultipleViolationsMessage
methods.description: Formats validation violation messages for sequence entries in the form.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Saves configuration values from the form and displays a success message.

methods.name: copyFormValuesToConfig
methods.description: Copies form values into the corresponding configuration object.

methods.name: checkConfigOverrides
methods.description: Adds messages if configuration values are overridden and provides links to override documentation.
